subject: MAP draft and procurement signature deadline
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@fintechco.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP draft (next steps & target close)

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the small MAP we discussed. Attached is the initial MAP draft (MAP_Draft_v1.pdf) with proposed milestones, owners, and a suggested target close date. Key points below: 

- Target close: Aug 20, 2026 (contract signature) — proposed by Redwood to align with your Q4 rollout plan.
- Procurement review: FinTechCo procurement to complete legal/terms review by Aug 5, 2026.
- Security evidence: we will provide SOC 2 and data flow docs by July 22 (Redwood action: Dylan).
- Pilot / PoC: 4-week pilot starting after signature; success criteria listed in MAP.

Please review the attached MAP and confirm: 1) whether Aug 20 works as the contract signature deadline for you, and 2) any additional procurement blockers we should include as dependencies (e.g., internal SSO review, budget committee sign-off).

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm procurement timeline and any other stakeholders (Procurement, Legal).
- Dylan to upload security docs to the shared Drive by Jul 22.
- We set a follow-up touchpoint w/ procurement on Jul 28 if review is on track.

Attachment: [Attachment: MAP_Draft_v1.pdf (pdf, 240KB)]

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if helpful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@fintechco.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft (next steps & target close)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and the MAP draft. Overall this looks good and matches what we talked about. A few notes from our side:

- Procurement has requested we aim for contract signature by Aug 25 rather than Aug 20 to accommodate an internal board meeting on Aug 23. Would Aug 25 work for Redwood?
- Procurement (cc'd) asked to confirm whether Redwood requires any PO to be in place before signature or if signature is sufficient to start the pilot.
- Legal will want a copy of the SLA and data processing addendum — can you include those in the shared Drive?

I'll follow up with Procurement to confirm. If we can keep the target within the week of Aug 23–27 that's ideal for our rollout.

--
Sarah Lee
Head of Product | FinTechCo
sarah.lee@fintechco.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@fintechco.com>, Procurement <procurement@fintechco.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft (next steps & target close)

Thanks Sarah — that window (Aug 23–27) is fine on our side. We can set Aug 25 as the procurement/contract signature deadline to align with your board schedule. 

To answer procurement's questions: 
- Signature vs PO: Signature is sufficient to kickoff the pilot and reserve capacity; if you prefer we can accept a PO as an additional step but it is not required to start the pilot.
- Docs: attaching the SLA and DPA links in the Drive now. Dylan is uploading SOC 2 and the network/data flow diagram by end of day Jul 22.

Attachment: [Drive links added: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAP]

Proposed updated MAP milestone highlights (from the draft):
- Jul 22: Security evidence deliverable (owner: Dylan Brooks)
- Aug 5: Procurement & Legal review complete (owner: Procurement - FinTechCo)
- Aug 12: Exec approval & budget sign-off (owner: Sarah Lee)
- Aug 18: Final redlines completed (owner: FinTechCo Legal + Redwood Legal)
- Aug 25: Contract signature (owner: FinTechCo + Redwood)
- Aug 26: Pilot kickoff (owner: FinTechCo + Redwood)

If Procurement confirms the Aug 25 signature date, we'll update the MAP_Draft_v1.pdf and circulate a MAP_Draft_v2 for final sign-off.

Best,
Marissa

From: Procurement <procurement@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@fintechco.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@fintechco.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Jul 2026 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft and procurement signature deadline

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the update and the flexibility on dates. A few quick clarifying items from procurement/legal: 

1) Aug 25 as signature date works conditionally on receiving the full SLA, DPA, and SOC 2 report by Jul 22 so we can complete internal review.
2) Please confirm whether Redwood's standard payment terms are Net 30 and whether we can request Net 45 for the first 90 days (we'll confirm on our end).
3) We prefer signature-only kickoffs; a PO is helpful but not mandatory.

Can Dylan send the SOC 2 link and DPA by EOD Jul 22 to procurement@fintechco.com? Also copying Tom (Legal) for any redline cycles.

Regards,
FinTechCo Procurement
procurement@fintechco.com

To: Procurement <procurement@fintechco.com>, Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@fintechco.com>

Subject: Re: MAP draft and procurement signature deadline

Thanks — noted and confirmed. Short answers: 

- We will deliver SOC 2 and DPA links to procurement@fintechco.com by EOD Jul 22 (Dylan assigned).
- Redwood standard payment terms: Net 30. We are open to Net 45 for the first 90 days; will confirm this in the contract redline (no blocker for signature).
- Signature-only kickoff confirmed (PO optional).

I'll push an updated MAP_Draft_v2 to the Drive with Aug 25 as the target signature date once SOC 2 is uploaded. Can we set a quick 15-min alignment with Procurement next Wed Jul 22 at 10am PT to confirm receipt of docs?

Thanks everyone — looking forward to closing this with you.

Best,
